announcements.title: Build your house in Jannah
announcements.content:
Whoever builds a Mosque for Allah, Allah will build a house like it in Jannah. (Sahih Al-Bukhari 439, Sahih Muslim 533)
Donations can be sent either via bank transfer, post or you can set up a regular standing order to the bank account. Thank you to all those who donate and support the mosque.
Please note that the donations are utilised for the maintenance of the mosque, education and other community activities that the mosque undertakes. 

Oscr Registered Charity Number: SC029765

announcements.title: Need your support to complete the repair
Continual rewards
announcements.content: As the Prophet SAW said: “Whoever builds a mosque for Allah, Allah will build for him a house like it in Paradise.” An ongoing donation for masjid means continual rewards in this life and the hereafter and makes an excellent form of sadaqah jariyah.

announcements.title: Daily Qur’an portion
announcements.content:
Remaining consistent” with your Ddaily Qur’an Portion is an achievement in itself 
it brings you satisfaction, peace, and comfort, 
and brings abundant blessings and goodness into your life.

And among the greatest losses is that your day has room for everything… except the Qur’an.

announcements.title: Daily Quran portion
announcements.content:
When you begin your day with your daily portion of Qur’an recitation and live your day connected to the Qur’an, do not think that Allah will withhold from you the blessings and effects of His Book. It is a great blessing in itself that He has chosen you to recite His words and guided you to this path.

Remaining steadfast in your daily Qur’an recitation fills your life with light, blessings, and divine guidance. Hold on to it, make it part of your life, and let it be your companion

announcements.title: দৈনিক কুরআন তেলাওয়াত
announcements.content:
যখন আপনি আপনার দিন শুরু করেন কুরআনের ওয়াজিব তেলাওয়াত দিয়ে এবং সারাদিন কুরআনের সঙ্গেই কাটান, তখন ভাববেন না যে আল্লাহ আপনাকে কুরআনের বরকত থেকে বঞ্চিত করবেন। এটা নিজেই একটি বিশাল নিয়ামত যে আল্লাহ আপনাকে তাঁর কালাম তেলাওয়াত করার তাওফিক দিয়েছেন এবং এই পথে আপনাকে পরিচালিত করেছেন।

কুরআনের দৈনিক ওয়াজিব তেলাওয়াতের উপর স্থির থাকা আপনার জীবনকে আলো, বরকত এবং আল্লাহর তাওফিকে ভরিয়ে দেয়। এটিকে আঁকড়ে ধরুন, আপনার জীবনের একটি অংশ বানান, এবং আপনার প্রতিটি চলাফেরার সঙ্গী করে তুলুন।

announcements.title: Supplication
announcements.content: Shaddad b. Aus said that God's Messenger used to say in his prayer, “O God, I ask Thee for steadfastness in carrying out what I am commanded and resolution in following right guidance. I ask Thee to make me grateful for Thy favour and to enable me to worship Thee acceptably. I ask Thee for a sound heart and a truthful tongue. I ask Thee for some of the good of what Thou knowest, I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of what Thou knowest, and I ask Thy forgiveness for what Thou knowest.”
